description: Áreas de riesgo potencial significativo de inundación en Asturias is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Principado de Asturias. Information on Areas of Significant Potential Flood Risk (ARPSI) in Asturias. The areas for which it has been concluded that there is a potential significant flood risk, or in which the materialisation of such a risk can be considered likely, as a result of the Preliminary Flood Risk Assessment (PRRA) work carried out within each ... Coverage: Principado de Asturias. The portal shows the English title as "Areas of potential significant flood risk in Asturias" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Principado de Asturias. Its keywords include Hidrografía, SADEI, Medio ambiente. The listing shows 2014-11-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es_ES). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
